system.description:
This skill only produces an effect when you are not receiving the effect of a [Summon Servant] skill. You gain a +[SRx5] bonus to damage rolls.

(SR3): During the Cleanup Process of each round, you may reduce your [Hate] by -1.

A battle style that unleashes a powerful blow by facing the heavens and earth with one body and turning oneself into the ancestral spirit itself, which is an aspect of nature.
